title: 第一卷 第18章 神魔遗迹，神庭的来历！
content_zh:
霎时间，那名手持令牌的无相士立刻催动手中的令牌，想要释放惊人威能。

    可下一瞬，他手中的令牌却不翼而飞。

    再定睛一看，令牌早已到了陆承锋手中。

    不等他反应过来，陆承锋手中的令牌便猛地向前刺去！

    那无相士彻底惊悚，双眼倏地瞪大。

    噗！

    令牌径直刺入他的嘴巴，撕裂了他的嘴角，贯穿了他的喉咙！

    尖锐的末端还从后脑勺穿出，带着猩红的鲜血和浑浊的脑浆！

    “呃……”

    那无相士闷哼一声，瞳孔迅速涣散，仰头倒了下去。

    而就在他倒地的瞬间，陆承锋的身影已再次消失！

    砰！

    随着无相士的尸体落地，陆承锋已出现在王德发的身前！

    唰！

    他探出的大手如同神鹰的利爪，狠狠抓向王德发的头顶。

    “啊，你……”

    王德发瞳孔骤缩，恐惧如同潮水般瞬间淹没了他。

    “纵容妻儿行凶作恶，到处掳掠，凌辱幼童，甚至敢掳掠到我女儿头上？”

    陆承锋沙哑的声音传出，带着彻骨的寒意，

    “你罪大恶极，今日，我便生撕了你！”

    下一瞬，他左手按住王德发的脑袋，右手五指骤然长出锋利的指甲，长达三十多公分，如同锋利的钢刀！

    唰唰唰！

    陆承锋的右手飞速舞动，几乎化作一道残影，伴随着血肉飞溅的声音，王德发的惨叫声凄厉地响起。

    “啊啊啊！！！”

    短短一两秒的时间，王德发全身的血肉便被削得干干净净！

    只剩下一具惨白的白骨。

    他那双布满血丝的瞳孔还在微微蠕动，写满了极致的惊恐。

    砰！

    陆承锋按在王德发头顶的左手，指甲也骤然变长，他猛地用力！

    砰！

    王德发的头颅如同西瓜般被抓爆，鲜血和脑浆溅了一地。

    堂堂武桥镇镇守大人，就此魂飞魄散！

    这一切发生得太过迅速，等其余的无相士和武桥镇的衙役反应过来，纷纷朝着陆承锋冲去时，王德发早已变成了一具无头白骨！

    鲜血将脚下的大地，染成了一片猩红。

    “啊，快，快杀了他！”

    莫洪嘶吼着，尽管心中有些发怵，但这般变故他们并非首次遇见！

    所有无相士立刻蜂拥而上，毫无惧色。

    其余的衙役和王家护卫，也第一时间抡起长刀，朝着陆承锋的后背斩去！

    “吼！”

    千钧一发之际，陆承锋猛地回头，朝着那些冲来的护卫和衙役厉声一吼！

    轰！！！！
content_en:
In an instant, the phaseless man holding the token immediately activated the token in his hand, wanting to release the astonishing power.

    But in the next moment, the token in his hand disappeared.

    Taking another closer look, the token was already in Lu Chengfeng's hands.

    Before he could react, the token in Lu Chengfeng's hand suddenly thrust forward!

    The phaseless man was completely horrified, and his eyes widened suddenly.

    puff!

    The token pierced directly into his mouth, tore the corners of his mouth, and penetrated his throat!

    The sharp end also penetrated from the back of the head, with scarlet blood and turbid brain matter!

    "Uh..."

    The phaseless man groaned, his pupils quickly dilated, and he threw his head back and fell down.

    And the moment he fell to the ground, Lu Chengfeng's figure had disappeared again!

    Bang!

    As the body of Wu Xiangshi fell to the ground, Lu Chengfeng appeared in front of Wang Defa!

    Uh-huh!

    The big hand he stretched out was like the sharp claws of a condor, and he grabbed Wang Defa's head hard.

    "Ah, you..."

    Wang Defa's pupils shrank suddenly, and fear instantly overwhelmed him like a tide.

    "You allowed your wife and children to commit crimes, robbed them everywhere, abused young children, and even dared to rob my daughter?"

    Lu Chengfeng's hoarse voice came out, with a chill to the bone,

    "You have committed a heinous crime. Today, I will tear you alive!"

    The next moment, he held Wang Defa's head with his left hand, and the five fingers of his right hand suddenly grew sharp nails, more than thirty centimeters long, like sharp steel knives!

    Swish, swish, swish!

    Lu Chengfeng's right hand danced rapidly, almost turning into an afterimage. Along with the sound of blood and flesh splashing, Wang Defa's screams rang out sadly.

    "Ahhhh!!!"

    In just one or two seconds, all the flesh and blood on Wang Defa's body was shaved cleanly!

    Only a pale skeleton was left.

    His bloodshot pupils were still squirming slightly, filled with extreme terror.

    Bang!

    Lu Chengfeng pressed his left hand on Wang Defa's head, and his nails suddenly grew longer. He exerted force!

    Bang!

    Wang Defa's head was scratched open like a watermelon, blood and brains splattered all over the floor.

    The dignified Lord Guard of Wuqiao Town was completely shattered!

    All this happened so quickly. By the time the rest of the Wuxiangshi and the government officials in Wuqiao Town reacted and rushed towards Lu Chengfeng, Wang Defa had already turned into a headless white skeleton!

    The blood dyed the ground beneath his feet scarlet.

    "Ah, hurry up, kill him quickly!"

    Mo Hong roared, even though he was a little frightened, this was not the first time they had encountered such a change!

    All the phaseless people immediately swarmed forward without any fear.

    The rest of the government officials and the Wang family guards also immediately raised their swords and slashed towards Lu Chengfeng's back!

    "Roar!"

    At the critical moment, Lu Chengfeng turned back sharply and shouted sharply at the rushing guards and government officials!

    boom! ! ! !
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 18 The ruins of gods and demons, the origin of the divine court!
